economy.summary: As the incumbent, she voted for the Raise the Wage Act (HB 1549) in June 2025, writing in a constituent newsletter that it would get more than one-fifth of Pennsylvania's workers a raise.
economy.short: Voted for Raise the Wage Act; one-fifth of workers affected.

taxes.summary: She sponsored House Bill 2300, passed by the House in June 2026, which would require businesses with repeated unfiled sales tax returns or delinquent balances over $5,000 to use authorized service providers for tax reporting; she said it would let businesses become compliant and get back on track serving their communities.
taxes.short: Sponsored bill helping tax-delinquent businesses become sales-tax compliant.

abortion.summary: She is a co-sponsor of House Bill 26 (introduced January 2025), which would protect abortion access up to 24 weeks, remove Pennsylvania's waiting-period, spousal-notification and parental-consent requirements, and prohibit government interference with abortion and contraception access.
abortion.short: Co-sponsors bill protecting abortion access, removing existing state restrictions.

education.summary: In a June 2025 constituent newsletter she said the childcare system is broken and that she stood with the Pennsylvania Child Care Association urging colleagues to adequately fund the childcare workforce.
education.short: Urges adequately funding childcare workforce; says childcare system broken.

healthcare.summary: She sponsored House Bill 1077, passed by the House in May 2026, which would create a Commission on Children's Vision within the Department of Health to plan for all students who need vision correction to receive eyeglasses at little or no cost.
healthcare.short: Sponsored bill giving students low-cost access to eyeglasses.

energy.summary: Her legislative record in this area is on natural gas infrastructure safety rather than environmental policy: she sponsored House Bills 1525 and 1526, responding to the 2023 West Reading factory explosion, to require steam pipeline registration with the One Call safety system and to direct the PUC to address degrading plastic natural gas pipelines.
energy.short: Sponsored natural gas pipeline safety bills after West Reading explosion.

guns.summary: She co-sponsored House Bill 1866 (2025), which would ban devices that convert semi-automatic firearms into machine guns; the bill was defeated on final House passage in October 2025 by a 101-102 vote.
guns.short: Co-sponsored ban on machine-gun conversion devices for firearms.
